# Silicon Labs
**Role(s):** Software Engineer (IoT / embedded C leaning)  
**Tier:** S  
**Status:** done-v3

> 🚪 [Start](../../START_HERE.md) · 🗺️ [Map](../../README.md) · 🏢 [Companies](../README.md) · 📚 [Library](../../library/README.md) · 🔍 [Find](../../FIND.md)

## Process Overview
Resume shortlist → 2 technical interviews → HR. Public GFG volume is thinner/older (internship-heavy); confirm year’s OA with placement cell.

## Online Assessment (OA)
- **Platform:** Often resume-first; OA not consistently documented in recent GFG campus writeups.
- **Expectation:** Embedded C + IoT awareness if role is software-on-silicon.

## Interview Rounds
- Deep resume grilling (everything listed).
- Embedded C / company tech stack awareness.
- HR: relocation (e.g. Hyderabad), family, 5-year plan, strengths.

## Topic Weights
| DSA | OS | C/C++ | DBMS | CN | LLD | HLD | Concurrency | Aptitude |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low | Med | High | None | Low | None | None | Low | Low |

## Recurring Patterns & Tips
- Know what Silicon Labs ships (IoT wireless) before the interview.
- Resume depth > DSA Hard.
